### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.windhand.net/tour-dates](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.windhand.net%2Ftour-dates) ### Comment > The Bandsintown tour/event listing on this Squarespace page fails when the AdGuard URL Tracking filter is enabled: > > https://www.windhand.net/tours > > The Squarespace/Bandsintown integration requests: > > https://rest.bandsintown.com/artists/Windhand/events?app_id=squarespace-windhand-band&date=upcoming > > The filter applies this rule: > > ||bandsintown.com^$removeparam=app_id > > which removes the `app_id` parameter. The resulting request is: > > https://rest.bandsintown.com/artists/Windhand/events?date=upcoming > > and the tour listing fails. > > I isolated this rule specifically in uBlock Origin 1.74.0 on Firefox 155: > > - With AdGuard/uBO – URL Tracking Protection enabled, the listing is broken. > - Disabling that filter list makes the listing work. > - Re-enabling the list and adding this local exception also makes the listing work: > > ||bandsintown.com^$removeparam=app_id,badfilter > > - Removing that local exception makes the listing fail again. > - The issue persists without custom filters/rules and with other browser extensions disabled. > > The uBlock Origin/uAssets maintainers directed me to report this to AdGuard because the offending rule comes from the AdGuard-maintained filter list. > > Related uAssets report: https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/issues/34546 > > This indicates that `app_id` is functionally required by this Squarespace/Bandsintown integration and removing it from this request breaks the tour listing. ### Screenshots

The resulting request is: > > https://rest.bandsintown.com/artists/Windhand/events?date=upcoming > > and the tour listing fails. > > I isolated this rule specifically in uBlock Origin 1.74.0 on Firefox 155: > > - With AdGuard/uBO – URL Tracking Protection enabled, the listing is broken. > - Disabling that filter list makes the listing work. > - Re-enabling the list and adding this local exception also makes the listing work: > > ||bandsintown.com^$removeparam=app_id,badfilter > > - Removing that local exception makes the listing fail again. > - The issue persists without custom filters/rules and with other browser extensions disabled. > > The uBlock Origin/uAssets maintainers directed me to report this to AdGuard because the offending rule comes from the AdGuard-maintained filter list. > > Related uAssets report: https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/issues/34546 > > This indicates that `app_id` is functionally required by this Squarespace/Bandsintown integration and removing it from this request breaks the tour listing. ### Screenshots
Screenshot 1 ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/nz7x5syxli8ggk0ck4k04k84kc800401nroetx236h.png?nc=1)
Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/oov95x2tl2osc08ookgcsos8gook08cq6jmlgu5u9w.png?nc=1)
### System configuration | Information | Value | |-------------|-------| Platform: | uBlock Origin v1.74.0 System version: | `MacOS 26.6.2 ` Browser: | Firefox Filters: | **Privacy:**
AdGuard URL Tracking filter Other extensions used: | `tested with all disabled`

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://aax-fe.amazon.co.jp/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Faax-fe.amazon.co.jp%2F)

### Comment
> Amazon.co.jpのトップページに並んでいるおすすめ商品画像のうち「スポンサー」マークのついたものはリンク先がhttps://www.amazon.co.jpではなくhttps://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpになっているようです。
> 
> AdGuard DNSを有効にした状態ではhttps://www.amazon.co.jpから始まるURLは開けますが、https://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpから始まるものは開けません。
> 
> AdGuard DNSを無効化した状態でhttps://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpから始まるリンクをクリックすると最終的にhttps://www.amazon.co.jpにリダイレクトされますが、有効化した状態ではリダイレクトがされずに添付画像のようなエラーメッセージがSafariから出力されました。

issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973
